wiki.title: Yassamin Ansari
wiki.extract: Yassamin Ansari ( YAH-sə-min an-SAH-ree, born April 7, 1992) is an American politician who serves as the U.S. representative for Arizona's 3rd congressional district since 2025. A progressive Democrat, she previously served on the Phoenix City Council from 2021 to 2024.
